entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Yes, I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse I received. I need to return it. I just...I need to return it!
I understand. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's under Michael Davis. But there's no order number. It was a gift. My...my friend, Jessica, gave it to me.
Okay, Michael. I can try looking it up using Jessica's name as well. And what seems to be the issue with the VeloBand Pulse?

The issue is... well, I need to return it, obviously. It's past the return date, I know, but listen, I have a very good reason. I was traveling. Overseas! For a while. And then, when I got back, I had to go straight to the hospital to see my mother. I just got back, and I'm trying to return it now.
I understand, Michael. I'm very sorry to hear about your mother. We certainly value our customers. Could you please provide me with either your friend’s name or email to look up the order?

Jessica Miller. Look, it's been a complete nightmare. I didn't even open it until today! That's how crazy it's been. I just saw it sitting there and realized I needed to return it immediately. I can't use it right now.
Okay, Michael. I’ve located the order under Jessica Miller. I see that the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on July 18th. Our return policy is 10 days from the delivery date.
Ten days? Seriously? Where was THAT written? I bet it was hidden in the fine print! I didn't see that anywhere obvious. This is ridiculous!

I understand your frustration, Michael. The return policy is stated on our website during the checkout process, and also in the confirmation email. I see the delivery was July 18th, which would put the return deadline at July 28th. I wish there was something I could do. Also, yesterday, our website crashed. I'm very sorry but I cannot process the return outside of our policy dates.

The website crashed? So everything's just falling apart over there, huh? Look, this is completely unfair. I told you, I was traveling, then the hospital...this isn't my fault! I want to speak to a supervisor. This is unacceptable!

I understand your frustration, Michael, but unfortunately, even a supervisor would be unable to override the return policy. The 10-day timeframe is firm. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, there isn't! This is useless! You people are impossible!
I apologize that I couldn't be more helpful today, Michael. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
